title: Photoaging of four microplastics under diverse conditions: characteristics and leachate composition studies
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00102E, Paper
Jing Yang, Jing He, Kening Tian
This study investigated the photoaging behavior of four microplastics within 120 days under different aging conditions (anoxic/UV, aerobic/UV, and aqueous/UV) and the composition evolution of their leachates.
